- Required systems (checklist)

- main.ts: must modify (add its own line) — e.g., print summary, ensure screenshots exist
- README.md with badges (give template), LICENSE exists (MIT), .makefun/owner.json exists
- Constraints: game ≤993 files, ≤48MiB, index.html ≤1MiB, no network refs (all data: or local files), no external CDN
- Original names: city "Vice Meridian"? Avoid "Vice" (GTA). Use "Port Solara". Characters original.
- Don't copy GTA assets/names.

Also instruct: work only inside /workspace/project/mf/bot, don't touch ../gta6-01-kit, don't git commit (I'll commit? Better: agent commits? Rules require commit; commits can be by me after build. But "thinking_committed" hashes transcripts; commit by me is fine.)

Actually simpler: agent writes files; I commit after. But "the recording must see your agent write every file of the entry" — commits don't matter.

Let me have the agent also run `MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR=out node main.ts` to verify, and run the screenshot script.

Prompt must be one big string passed to `opencode run`. Let me write the prompt to a file and pass "$(cat file)".

Let me write the prompt now.

One more consideration: opencode's model deepseek-v4.1-flash may be weak for a big 3D game. Consider using a stronger model on obscurify: e.g., `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` (coding), `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5` or `openai/gpt-5.2` (strong but pricier). Cost per key $1. deepseek flash is ~$0.0003/req — thousands of requests affordable. But quality matters.

Let me use glm-5.3-flash or claude-sonnet. Hmm. Cost: claude-sonnet-5 ~$0.003-0.01/request; a big build might be 200-500 requests → $1-5 → spans multiple keys. Acceptable (we have $100 across 103 keys).

But switching keys mid-run requires config change — messy. deepseek flash with $1 could do ~3000 requests.

Given quality vs cost, let me start with deepseek flash (cheap, decent) for scaffolding, and if quality poor, switch to glm-5.3-flash for polish iterations (new recording sessions allowed — multiple recordings can be submitted comma-separated).

Actually the transcripts must all be within window and witnessed; multiple recordings OK.

Decision: start with `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` maybe? Let me check its cost from earlier probe: glm-5.3-flash cost $0.000267 for hi. So ~$0.0003/req → similar to deepseek. And GLM is better at coding. Let me check obscurify model list: `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` exists. Use that.

Hmm, but reasoning_content? GLM 5.3 flash had reasoning 140 chars — fine.

Let me use `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` as primary model for build. Update opencode config models list to include it.

Let me test opencode with glm-5.3-flash quickly (one call), then write prompt.

Time is short; combine: update config + test.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os
p=os.path.expanduser("~/.config/opencode/opencode.json")
c=json.load(open(p))
c["provider"]["obscurify"]["models"]["z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"]={"name":"GLM 5.3 Flash"}
c["model"]="obscurify/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"
json.dump(c,open(p,"w"),indent=2)
print("model default:",c["model"])
PY
export OBSCURIFY_API_KEY="$(cat ~/.obscurify_key)" && cd /tmp && timeout 150 /workspace/project/mf/tools/node_modules/.bin/opencode run --model obscurify/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash "Reply with exactly: READY" 2>&1 | tail -5
